import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
note='Delivery provenance limit: the DOI and publisher full/abstract routes were returned by authoritative search navigation; the selected /doi/pdf/ endpoint was constructed using Wiley standard DOI routing, not extracted from a separately acquired landing-page PDF hyperlink. It returned403; no successful delivery authentication or final-body comparison is claimed.'
s=Path('PRIMARY-COMPARISONS.md').read_text();s=s.replace('O2 is HOLD. The cached v2',note+' O2 is HOLD. The cached v2');w('PRIMARY-COMPARISONS.md',s)
s=Path('REVIEW.md').read_text();s+='\n'+note+'\n';w('REVIEW.md',s)
k=json.loads(Path('keyedreview.json').read_text());k['delivery_provenance_limit']=note;w('keyedreview.json',json.dumps(k,indent=2))
a=json.loads(Path('access-inventory.json').read_text());a['delivery_provenance_limit']=note;w('access-inventory.json',json.dumps(a,indent=2))
for f in ['keyedreview.json','source-obligation-map.json','source-read-inventory.json','input-inventory.json','access-inventory.json','search-inventory.json','figure-inventory.json','resource-inventory.json','search1-response.json','search2-response.json']:
 json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
 print('VALID_JSON',f)
rs=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());rs.append((f.name,o.get('exit'),o.get('killed')))
print('RECEIPT_EXITS',rs)
assert [(n,e) for n,e,k in rs if e not in (None,0)]==[('get_jgt_final.receipt.json',1)]
assert all(k is None for n,e,k in rs)
print('Reports complete; preciseO2gap and failed receipt retained. All prior runner jobs reaped.')
